description: From the article:"Pennsylvania just got one step closer to protecting our beloved native bees, butterflies and other pollinators. House Resolution 66, which directs state officials to study how to best manage the state’s native bees, butterflies and other insects native to Pennsylvania passed the Pennsylvania House by a bipartisan vote of 112-89 on Monday, May 4th 2026. title: Protecting Bees, Butterflies, and Other Pollinators in PA
